# Results — Study 638 (Value-Momentum-Everywhere)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test
(Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen 2013) — **value and momentum premia exist in every asset
class, they are negatively correlated, and the 50/50 combo is the real free lunch** —
rebuilt on free data with one uniform recipe in four sleeves. Offline & deterministic
once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every number. As-of
**2026-05-31** (the shared futures cache ends 2026-06-11, so June 2026 is a partial
month and is dropped). Fingerprint `2cd41e1339cb`.*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| EQ sleeve | 13 country equity ETFs (SPY + 12 iShares MSCI singles), yfinance dividend-adjusted **total-return** closes, monthly 1996-02 → 2026-05. **Survivors** (all still trade in 2026) — named on the Signal axis |
| FX sleeve | 9 G10 pairs vs USD, yfinance **spot** (price-only — **no carry**, labeled), monthly 1996-11 → 2026-05 |
| BOND sleeve | ZF/ZN/ZB US Treasury futures, daily **excess** returns from the shared continuous-futures cache (roll noise, ±25% clip — see [study 31](../../31-trade-winds/)), monthly 2000-10 → 2026-05 |
| CMD sleeve | CL/GC/SI/HG/NG/ZC/ZS/ZW commodity futures, same cache, monthly 2000-08 → 2026-05 |
| Signals | **VALUE** = 5-year reversal (−cum return, months t−59..t−12); **MOMENTUM** = 12-1 (months t−11..t−1); complete windows, computed from data through month-end *t* only |
| Books / lag | long top third, short bottom third, equal weight (gross 2× NAV), monthly rebalance; **one execution lag** (signal at close of month *t*, position earns month *t*+1) |
| Costs | one-way bps × traded notional (avg combo one-way turnover **0.65× NAV/month**); EQ short leg pays **50 bps/yr** borrow; Sharpe races are excess-vs-excess (L/S self-financing; futures excess by construction) |

## The ingredients — eight legs, four sleeves (gross, HAC t)

| sleeve | VAL SR | VAL *t* | MOM SR | MOM *t* | COMBO SR | COMBO *t* | ρ(V,M) | n | live from |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|---|
| EQ (13 country ETFs) | −0.25 | −1.35 | −0.01 | −0.06 | −0.16 | −0.73 | −0.16 | 349 | 1997-05 |
| FX (9 G10 spot) | +0.10 | +0.46 | −0.01 | −0.07 | +0.04 | +0.20 | −0.03 | 270 | 2002-09 |
| BOND (ZF/ZN/ZB) | −0.22 | −1.19 | −0.19 | −0.97 | −0.36 | −1.63 | −0.11 | 203 | 2001-11 |
| CMD (8 futures) | +0.14 | +0.67 | −0.32 | −1.72 | −0.15 | −0.86 | +0.17 | 296 | 2001-10 |

Not one of the eight legs is distinguishable from zero (\|*t*\| < 2 everywhere). The
famous **hedge** — AMP report ρ(VAL, MOM) ≈ −0.5 within asset classes — shows up as a
mean per-sleeve **ρ = −0.03** on this tape.

## The claim under test — the global everywhere portfolios

Equal-weight average of live sleeves (≥ 2 required):

| leg | Sharpe | HAC *t* | mean (bps/mo) | n |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| GLOBAL VALUE | +0.01 | +0.03 | +0.4 | 248 |
| GLOBAL MOMENTUM | −0.38 | −1.95 | −28.0 | 296 |
| **GLOBAL 50/50 COMBO** | **−0.29** | **−1.49** | **−15.7** | **296** |

The combo — the paper's free-lunch claim — fails the *t* ≥ 2 bar with the **wrong
sign**. Sub-periods (split at AMP's 2011 sample edge — justified, not snooped):
≤2011 SR **−0.50** (HAC *t* = −1.64, n = 123); ≥2012 SR **−0.13** (*t* = −0.54,
n = 174). Neither half shows anything; the AMP-overlap half is the *worse* one, so
this is not even a clean post-publication-decay story — the combo never appears on
this free tape at all.

## Third axis — is the combo just diversification arithmetic?

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| global ρ(VAL, MOM) | **+0.145** (n = 248) |
| ingredient Sharpes | SR_val **+0.01**, SR_mom **−0.41** |
| predicted combo SR (two-asset formula) | **−0.267** |
| realized combo SR (same 50/50 mix) | **−0.267** (gap 0.0000) |

**CONFIRMED** — the combo's Sharpe equals the textbook two-asset formula exactly.
"Everywhere" adds nothing beyond diversification arithmetic, which **multiplies its
ingredients**: real ones in AMP's 1972–2011 sample, ≈ zero here, and pure noise in the
null twin [study 401 — signal-stacking](../../401-signal-stacking/).

## Random-signal placebo (50 seeds — house rule ≥ 20)

Random-rank signals through the identical pipeline: mean global-combo Sharpe
**+0.01** (sd 0.19), mean HAC *t* **+0.07**, fraction \|*t*\| ≥ 2 = **4%**. The
construction is unbiased — and the real-signal combo (−0.29) sits *inside* the noise
band, on the wrong side.

## Robustness — construction variants (global combo, gross)

| variant | SR | HAC *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| top/bottom **halves** instead of thirds | −0.48 | −2.40 |
| momentum **12-0** (no skip-month) | −0.34 | −1.76 |
| value **including** the last year | −0.19 | −0.88 |

Every variant is negative-to-flat; the halves variant is actually *significantly*
negative. There is no construction under which this tape pays the combo.

## Synthetic control — the machinery is faithful

The same pipeline on a deterministic 4-sleeve world with plantable cross-sectional
value/momentum edges (`data.synthetic_world`, seed 638, 480 months):

| world | VAL SR | MOM SR | COMBO SR | COMBO HAC *t* | formula SR | realized SR |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| null (no edges) | −0.04 | −0.07 | −0.08 | −0.52 | −0.13 | −0.13 |
| planted VAL+MOM edges | +2.27 | +1.49 | +2.32 | +14.12 | +2.51 | +2.51 |

With nothing planted the pipeline reports nothing; with planted edges both legs light
up and the combo again equals the diversification formula. *(A machinery proof only —
never cited in support of a stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — WEAK.** The literature (AMP 2013) says the premia are real; **this tape
  cannot certify any of it**: all eight sleeve-legs at \|*t*\| < 2, hedge correlation
  ≈ 0, global combo SR −0.29 with HAC *t* = −1.49 (296 months), nothing in either
  sub-period. Survivor ETFs, spot-only FX and roll-noisy futures are named — they blur
  the measurement, but they cannot manufacture a premium that is not there.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** Gross is already −1.88%/yr at 0.65× NAV monthly one-way
  turnover; 10 bps one-way + EQ borrow takes it to −2.81%/yr. Nothing to harvest.
- **Just diversification arithmetic? — CONFIRMED.** Realized combo SR = formula SR to
  the 4th decimal (−0.267). The free lunch is √-arithmetic times the ingredients — and
  the free tape supplies no ingredients.
